$sources: E.030 2018 (Diseño Sismorresistente): 10-14 (Z, soil profiles S0-S3, S, TP, TL, C), 15-16 (U, systems), 18-22 (R0, Ia, Ip), 26-29 (weight, period, static and modal analysis), 31-32 (drift); see VERIFY.md
source: E.030 2018: Sa = Z U C S g / R, R = R0 Ia Ip (Ia = Ip = 1: regular buildings), C = 2.5 below TP, 2.5 TP/T to TL, 2.5 TP TL/T² beyond (1 + 7.5 T/TP below 0.2 TP for the modal analysis, 29.2.2), C/R ≥ 0.11 (28.2.1); by the generic shapeFactors spectrum method (Z, U as Z and I, R0 as μ, Sp = 1, kμ = μ, S by soil and Z as its soil factors). Entered from knowledge of the standard, every value to be checked against the printed standard (VERIFY.md).

S0.description: Soil profile S0: hard rock (vs above 1500 m/s; TP 0.3 s, TL 3.0 s)

S1.description: Soil profile S1: rock or very stiff soil (vs 500-1500 m/s; TP 0.4 s, TL 2.5 s)

S2.description: Soil profile S2: intermediate soil (vs 180-500 m/s; TP 0.6 s, TL 2.0 s)

S3.description: Soil profile S3: soft soil (vs below 180 m/s; TP 1.0 s, TL 1.6 s)

designSpectrum.clause: E.030 2018 28.2.1 (V = Z U C S P / R) and 29.2.1 (Sa = Z U C S g / R)

clauses.performance: E.030 2018 22 (R = R0 Ia Ip as the system's R; no Sp)
clauses.soil: E.030 2018 13, Table 3 (S by zone and soil profile)

clauses.static: E.030 2018 28.2.1 (C = 2.5 below TP for the static method)

lateralForce.clause: E.030 2018 28.3 (Fi = αi V, αi = Pi hi^k / Σ Pj hj^k, k = 1 for T ≤ 0.5 s, 0.75 + 0.5 T ≤ 2 beyond)

clauses.scale: E.030 2018 29.4 (modal base shear at least 80 % of the static one, 90 % irregular)
clauses.drift: E.030 2018 31-32, Table 11 (0.007 concrete, 0.010 steel and timber, 0.005 masonry; 0.75 R × the elastic displacements)
clauses.sdc: SAEngine practice: the detailing by zone (zones 3-4 special, 2 intermediate, 1 ordinary)
clauses.weight: E.030 2018 26 (dead load + 50 % of the live load for categories A and B, 25 % for C, 80 % storage, 25 % roofs)

sources.siteClasses: E.030 2018 12, Table 2 (soil profiles by vs) and Table 4: TP 0.3, 0.4, 0.6, 1.0 s, TL 3.0, 2.5, 2.0, 1.6 s for S0-S3; C as shape branches (the last one 2.5 (√(TP TL)/T)² = 2.5 TP TL/T²); S4 (exceptional conditions) needs a site-specific study and is not offered
sources.systems: E.030 2018 Table 7: R0 (Ia = Ip = 1); Cd = 0.75 R0 (31.1, regular); Omega0: SAEngine practice (E.030 gives no overstrength factor; the ASCE 7 values of the same systems, on the safe side where used)
sources.periodCoefficients: E.030 2018 28.4.1: T = hn / CT, CT = 35 (frames only), 45 (concrete frames with walls at lifts and stairs, steel braced frames), 60 (walls, dual, masonry): Ct = 1/CT, m = 1
sources.designCategories: SAEngine practice: E.030 has no Seismic Design Category
sources.minimumScale: E.030 2018 29.4: 80 % of the static base shear (regular), 90 % (irregular: enter 0.9)
sources.verticalFactor: E.030 2018 29.2.3: the vertical spectrum 2/3 of the horizontal (check the clause)
